hook: Manhattan federal court heard the confession that exposed a massive $500 million financial scheme.

sections.voiceover: Manhattan federal court heard the confession that exposed a massive $500 million financial scheme.
b_roll: Exterior shot of Manhattan federal courthouse

sections.voiceover: Josh Wander, aged 45, admitted to wire fraud in Manhattan. Prosecutors in Miami charged 777 Partners with bilking lenders out of funds. Where did those millions vanish?
But Miami-based 777 Partners couldn't hide securities fraud across the multi-layered operation.
Guilty pleas revealed $500 million in losses tied to Manhattan federal court. Lenders lost $500 million before the firm collapsed completely in court.
The Manhattan courtroom recorded the final $500 million guilty plea.
